h1: Automation monitoring and a first round of fixes
overview: Automations fail quietly: a login expires, a field is renamed, a tool changes its rules. This is a fixed starter sprint, not a monthly plan. We review your automations, fix what is broken, add alerts for failures and write a short report on their health. If you then want ongoing monthly watching, we quote that separately.

faq: No. It is a one-time starter sprint at a fixed price. If you want us to watch your automations every month afterwards, that is quoted separately based on how many you run.
Can you fix automations someone else built?
Often yes. We need collaborator access to the automation tool and a look at how each flow works. If one is too tangled to repair safely, we say so and suggest a rebuild.
Expired logins, renamed fields, full plan limits, changed website forms and tools that update their connections. The health check tests for each of these.
What do you need to start?
Access to your automation tool, such as Zapier or Make, as a collaborator, and a list of what each flow should do. We never ask for your passwords.
